step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features three main processing paths: 1) Client access path where mobile/web CLIENTS connect through API Gateway to ECS and query DynamoDB. 2) An event-driven processing path starting from SNS notifying Step Functions, which orchestrates Fargate tasks that call Rekognition for keyframe text extraction and pass offset data to a Lambda function. 3) A real-time data ingestion path where Kinesis Analytics filters event feeds and sends them to the Lambda function.

graph.name: DAZN Key Moments Video Processing Architecture
graph.notes: Push-based video overlay synchronization architecture using Fargate, Rekognition, Lambda, Kinesis Analytics, ECS, and DynamoDB.
